svg.title: An explicit retained-reference instrument is Ic(ω) = √Ec ω√Ec and I0(ω) = √E0 ω√E0, with the identity on an arbitrary reference, and orthogonal recorded flags. Its probabilities on a correlated two-register input are Tr(Ecω12); they factor as ηxy only under the declared product preparation. This needs two preparations, not a machine cloning an unknown input. The standard isometry V = |c⟩√Ec + |0⟩√E0 provides a finite apparatus dilation, but a material coupling remains to be supplied. The square roots specify a state update not determined by the scalar rate alone.
